answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11991 Country: India Title: Assalamu Alaikum, hope this question will be answred as early as posible. The question is about travel expenses given by the company to the employee. can a employee use the remaining expenses for himself or should he give it back to the company? Wassalam. Question: Assalamu Alaikum, hope this question will be answred as early as posible. The question is about travel expenses given by the company to the employee. can a employee use the remaining expenses for himself or should he give it back to the company? Wassalam. Answer ID: 11991 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 832/617=H/1430) It should be returned to the company, but if the company allows the employees to use the remaining amount, then it is not wajib to return it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
